name: Museo Nacional Thyssen-Bornemisza
known: The Ministry's Directorate General of Fine Arts covered the operating deficit with €18,566,850 in 2024.

name: Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art Sri Lanka

An eight-member Board of Directors meets with the leadership team every other month.
